config.image_loading: preloaded once into memory (uint8 grayscale, cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE) before timing; excluded from all timers
config.timed_region: detection + decode of a preloaded grayscale array; no disk I/O, no import, no decoder construction
config.zxingcpp_call: zxingcpp.read_barcode(gray, formats=BarcodeFormat.QRCode) with library defaults (try_rotate=True, try_downscale=True, try_invert=True)

threading.notes: zxing-cpp core is single threaded (no thread pool); /proc/self/task counts recorded per implementation

config.accuracy_rule: exact match to 'rikvoorhaar.com' after remove NULs + strip whitespace
